senses.sense_definition: Existing at the same time or belonging to the same period.

examples.text: The ancient pottery found in the cave is <w>coeval</w> with the nearby stone tools.
These two historical documents are <w>coeval</w> and provide a clear picture of that era.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is of the same age as another.

examples.text: She felt much more comfortable talking to her <w>coevals</w> than to the older generation.
The student struggled to relate to his <w>coevals</w> because of his advanced academic interests.

senses.sense_definition: Something that exists during the same historical period as another thing.

examples.text: The steam engine and the early telegraph are <w>coevals</w> of the industrial revolution.
These architectural styles are <w>coevals</w> from the late nineteenth century.
